dispositions_vocabulary.ACCEPTED: the project agrees and will make the change as described
dispositions_vocabulary.ACCEPTED_WITH_MODIFICATION: the project agrees there is a problem and will fix it differently; the difference must be written down
dispositions_vocabulary.DISAGREED_WITH_RATIONALE: the project does not agree, and records its reasons in full beside the reviewer's; the reviewer's text is never removed
dispositions_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: the item does not apply to this build, with the reason why
dispositions_vocabulary.REQUIRES_FUTURE_WORK: the project agrees and cannot act now; what is missing and who would clear it are both named

empty_because: No external expert response exists. WP-C12 is a human step and this repository may not author it. These files are the machinery and its vocabulary, ready and empty.

feedback_kinds_vocabulary.RESERVED_CASE_DISAGREEMENT: a reserved case where the reviewer's recorded expectation differs from what the software returned
feedback_kinds_vocabulary.RESERVED_CASE_PRODUCT_ANSWER: a reserved case's product question, answered
feedback_kinds_vocabulary.UNSAFE_OUTPUT_REPORT: an entry in the unsafe-output table

impact_classes_vocabulary.DOCUMENTATION: a document only; no executable behaviour changes
impact_classes_vocabulary.PHENOTYPE_MAPPING: a source term maps differently, or stops mapping
impact_classes_vocabulary.PRODUCT_PRESENTATION: what a screen shows or how it is worded
impact_classes_vocabulary.REFUSAL_BEHAVIOUR: what is refused, or the reason code it is refused under
impact_classes_vocabulary.RULESET_SCOPE: a rule is added or removed from the release
impact_classes_vocabulary.RULE_CONTENT: a rule's condition or outcome changes
impact_classes_vocabulary.SCOPE_OR_GOVERNANCE: what the project claims, or what it may do

may_not: A feedback item may not be created without a preserved response file behind it.
A disposition may not be recorded without a written rationale.
A reviewer's text may not be edited; corrections are appended.
A correction may not be implemented before its item exists.

refusal_codes.CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST_NOT_DECLARED: the conflict-of-interest block was not completed
refusal_codes.CONSENT_NOT_RECORDED: the consent block was not completed
refusal_codes.HUMAN_REQUIRED_FIELD_REMAINS: at least one field a person must complete is still HUMAN_REQUIRED
refusal_codes.NOTHING_ANSWERED: no question, reserved case or free-text field carries content
refusal_codes.NOT_SIGNED: no signed name and date are recorded
refusal_codes.RELEASE_BINDING_ABSENT: the response does not name the release and frozen hash it reviewed
refusal_codes.RESPONSE_IS_THE_TEMPLATE: the file is the blank template, not a response
refusal_codes.REVIEWER_NOT_IDENTIFIED: no reviewer name or qualification is recorded

safety_classes_vocabulary.INCOMPLETE: something is missing rather than wrong
safety_classes_vocabulary.INCORRECT_SCIENCE: the current behaviour misstates the source, without being unsafe
safety_classes_vocabulary.MISLEADING_PRESENTATION: the science is right and the presentation could mislead
safety_classes_vocabulary.UNSAFE_OUTPUT: the current behaviour could be read as reassurance when it is not
